remarks: Walk to East Norwalk Train Station!  East Norwalk location on Mill Pond - 2 BR 1 BTH. Newly updated kitchen and bathroom. Freshly painted throughout. New stainless steel appliances and granite counters. Good closet space/ great cabinet and counter space in Eat-in-kitchen. Park in rear parking space #2 and enter unit from rear deck. Lots of natural light. Full-sized Washer and Dryer and dishwasher in unit. Gas heat and cooking. Own thermostat. Off street assigned parking. Walk to SONO, train station, bus, restaurants, shopping, nightlife, Vets park, Norwalk Harbor. Take a relaxing bike ride to Calf Pasture Beach. No pets. No smoking. BR #2 is TwinBed-size - perfect for child's bedroom or office. Watch the swans and ducklings swim along the pond as you sit on your deck.
